monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.night.title: Monarch of Night
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.night.domain: Foes are weakened, slowed and worn down by the dark, and your shadows hit harder and mend.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.night.lore: Whatever your class, the fallen rise again as your shadows.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.winter.title: Monarch of Winter
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.winter.domai: Foes are slowed and chilled until they freeze, and the cold bites them every second.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.winter.lore: Everything ends in silence, under the snow.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.cinders.doma: Foes catch fire and burn, and the flames bite them every second.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.cinders.lore: Every fire is a crown, and every crown will burn.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.thunder.doma: Lightning falls on the foes inside, one after another, stunning those it strikes.
monarch.beyondsolo.dominion.thunder.lore: The sky does not ask permission.
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.title: THE EMPTY THRONE
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.intro: Cut down the fallen court. Break the Arbiter. Claim the throne.
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.court_next: The court is not done with you...
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.arbiter_near: Before the throne, something kneeling breaks its chains.
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.arbiter_flawles: Flawless so far: don't let it touch you
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.arbiter_down: The Arbiter falls. The throne is open.
monarch.beyondsolo.trial.failed_sub: The throne casts you out. You may return in %s minutes.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_called.title: [The Throne Calls]
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_called.body: Beyond the gates, an empty throne waits for you. Raise the Sigil of Dominion when you are ready to claim it.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_countdown.body: The sigil answers. You will face the throne alone.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_crowned.title: Monarch ascension complete
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_crowned.body: You are now %s. Your crown's powers wait on the crown keys.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_wait.title: The Empty Throne
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_wait.body: The throne is sealed for %s:%s more.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_not_here.title: The Empty Throne
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_not_here.body: The throne can't reach you here.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_sigil_quiet.bo: The sigil is quiet. You are already %s.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_sigil_waits.bo: The sigil stays cold. Change your job and reach level %s first.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_returned.title: The Empty Throne
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_returned.body: You left the hall of the throne. You can try again.
notify.beyondsolo.monarch_returned_crown: You left the hall, but the crown is yours: you are %s.
chat.beyondsolo.monarch_crowned: %s has claimed the empty throne and become %s!
quest.beyondsolo.monarch_throne.desc: Few hunters ever grow strong enough to hear it: an empty throne, calling. Raise the Sigil of Dominion and face its hall alone. Whoever sits on it leaves a monarch.
title.beyondsolo.monarch_of_night.desc: Claim the crown of Night at the empty throne.
title.beyondsolo.monarch_of_winter.desc: Claim the crown of Winter at the empty throne.
title.beyondsolo.monarch_of_cinders.desc: Claim the crown of Cinders at the empty throne.
title.beyondsolo.monarch_of_thunder.desc: Claim the crown of Thunder at the empty throne.
title.beyondsolo.unblemished_crown.desc: Bring down the Arbiter Unchained without letting it touch you.
title.beyondsolo.crown_against_crown.des: As a monarch, have a share in slaying a monarch from beyond the gates.
title.beyondsolo.domain_unbowed.desc: Hold back a monarch's domain with your own.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_domain.flavour: Where a monarch stands, the world obeys another law.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_domain.desc: Lay down your rule for %s s, %s blocks round you, and carry it with you. Inside it you and your allies deal %s%% more and take %s%% less, every foe suffers your crown's power (%s damage a second), and no monarch's domain can touch those it shelters.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_dread.flavour: Even beasts know when they are prey.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_dread.desc: Let your killing intent loose: every foe within %s blocks freezes in terror for %s s, weakened and slowed, and takes %s%% more from every blow for %s s. Bosses only flinch, and take half as much more.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_crown.flavour: For a little while, what you truly are.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_crown.desc: Take your true form for %s s: your blows deal %s%% more and carry your crown's element, you take %s%% less, you move faster and are hard to knock back. You can still be hurt.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_eclipse.flavour: When the sun goes out, the dead rise for their king.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_eclipse.desc: The sun goes out round you: every foe within %s blocks is bound in the dark for %s s and struck three times for %s damage, and your whole army rises at once, mended and free, dealing %s%% more for %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_long_winter.fla: A winter that remembers the end of the world.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_long_winter.des: Call the cold of an age: everything within %s blocks freezes solid for %s s, taking %s damage each second, then shatters for %s more.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_ashen_heaven.fl: The sky burns, and its ash falls like rain.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_ashen_heaven.de: Tear a burning star out of the sky onto where you look: %s damage to foes within %s blocks, thrown back and set ablaze, and the ground burns on for %s s, %s damage each second.
skill.beyondsolo.monarch_thousand_thunde: The sky answers you: %s bolts fall one after another on the foes within %s blocks, %s damage each, stunning what they strike and leaping on to one more.
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.clash.monarch: a monarch from beyond the gates
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.throne.sub: Choose the crown you will wear. It will be yours for good.
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.throne.every: Every crown also gives Dread, Crown Form and a monarch's strength: more health, heavier blows, more mana and more shadows at your side.
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.throne.keys: Click a crown or press 1-4 to choose · Enter to claim
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.throne.waiting: The throne waits for your answer
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.throne.looked_away: The throne still waits. Press %s to answer it.
ui.beyondsolo.monarch.coronation.footer: Stronger than any hunter, and still within another crown's reach.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.cro: Crowns them at once: a monarch of that crown, with its powers and strength.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.unc: Takes the crown back: its powers and strength are gone; shadows keep their rank.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.cal: Calls them to the empty throne now, whatever they hold or their level.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.res: Wipes their monarch record: no crown, never called, no wait for the throne.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.jum: Skips their running throne trial to a court wave, the Arbiter or the throne (with a crown named, it is claimed at once).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.monarch.pow: Uses one of their crown's powers now: their mana is refilled and every cooldown cleared first.
command.beyondsolo.solo.monarch.called: %s has been called to the empty throne.
command.beyondsolo.solo.trial.throne: %s is taken to the empty throne.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.not_in_thr: %s is not in the throne trial.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_cr: Unknown crown: %s. Use night, winter, cinders or thunder.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_po: Unknown power: %s. Use domain, dread, crown or authority.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.unknown_tr: There is no part %s: use 1, 2, arbiter, throne or a crown.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.power_fail: %s couldn't use %s here (no foes in reach?).
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.monarch: %s · monarchs slain %s · domains held %s · authorities used %s
command.beyondsolo.solo.info.monarch_cal: Called to the empty throne · tries %s
